fusions.name: Branching Spurs
fusions.desc: Spurs burst from your plate, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Calcite Barb
fusions.desc: Sheds a barb that deals 7 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; a kill grows one back.

fusions.name: Mending Reef
fusions.desc: You regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds, and your physical resistance rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
